# Security policy

This repository is a fork of [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code). It ships its own
desktop and iOS builds and runs its own T3 Connect relay, none of which T3 Tools operates.

- **Fork builds, fork-only code, or this fork's relay:** report privately to the fork maintainer,
  [@Bl4ckBl1zZ](https://github.com/Bl4ckBl1zZ), through
  [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Bl4ckBl1zZ/t3code/security/advisories/new).
  Do not send these to T3 Tools.
- **Upstream T3 Code itself** (reproducible on an official T3 Code release): follow the
  [upstream security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy).

Please do not disclose a vulnerability publicly until it has been investigated and fixed.
